list_suites.title: List test suites
list_suites.description: List the organization's test suites, each with its description, shared instructions and the login flow it runs before each test.

output.description: The suites with their ids, names and context, plus a count.

get_suite.title: Get a test suite
get_suite.description: Read one suite by id, with its description, suite-level instructions and authentication setup.

output.description: The suite record.

create_suite.title: Create a test suite
create_suite.description: Create a suite to group flows. instructions is shared context injected into the agent's prompt for every flow in it; auth_instructions is a login sequence that actually runs before each flow, and can reference secrets as ${env:NAME}.

name.description: Name of the suite, 1 to 255 characters.

instructions.description: Shared context for the agent, applied to every flow in the suite.

auth_instructions.description: Login steps run before each flow; use ${env:NAME} for credentials.

output.description: The created suite, with its id.

update_suite.title: Update a test suite
update_suite.description: Change a suite's name, description, shared instructions or login steps. Passing null to description or instructions clears them.

instructions.description: New shared context; null clears it.

auth_instructions.description: New login steps run before each flow in the suite.

output.description: The updated suite.

delete_suite.title: Delete a test suite
delete_suite.description: Delete a suite. The flows in it survive as standalone flows; only the grouping and its shared context go.

output.description: Empty on success.

list_flows.title: List test flows
list_flows.description: List the organization's flows, or just those in one suite, with the natural-language instructions each runs.

suite_id.description: Restrict to the flows in this suite, in suite order.

output.description: The flows with their ids, names and instructions.

get_flow.title: Get a test flow
get_flow.description: Read one flow by id, with its instructions, device requirement and the suites it belongs to.

output.description: The flow record.

create_flow.title: Create a test flow
create_flow.description: Write a test in plain English. instructions is what the agent executes -- describe user-visible behaviour rather than selectors -- and suite_id attaches the flow to a suite as it is created.

name.description: Name of the flow, 1 to 255 characters.

instructions.description: Natural-language steps for the agent to perform.

suite_id.description: Suite to attach the new flow to.

output.description: The created flow, with its id.

update_flow.title: Update a test flow
update_flow.description: Change a flow's name, instructions or device requirement. device_count 2 is for tests that span two devices, and the update is refused if it would break a suite the flow belongs to.

device_count.description: How many devices the flow needs, 1 or 2.

output.description: The updated flow.

delete_flow.title: Delete a test flow
delete_flow.description: Delete a flow and its history from the organization. Suites that included it simply lose the entry.

output.description: Empty on success.

add_flow_to_suite.title: Add a flow to a suite
add_flow_to_suite.description: Attach an existing flow to a suite, so it runs with that suite's shared context and login steps.

output.description: Confirmation that the flow is in the suite.

remove_flow_from_suite.title: Remove a flow from a suite
remove_flow_from_suite.description: Detach a flow from a suite. The flow itself survives as a standalone test.

output.description: Empty on success.

run_flows.title: Run flows, suites or labels
run_flows.description: Start a test run. Name the target app -- app_id for a web app, or bundle_id with platform for mobile -- and what to run, as suite_ids, flow_ids or label names. Returns a batch_id to poll with get_run_status.

app_id.description: Web app id to run against. Required unless bundle_id is given.

bundle_id.description: Mobile app bundle identifier. Required unless app_id is given.

app_build_id.description: Pin the run to this build instead of the app's active one.

suite_overrides.description: Which suite's context to use for a flow that belongs to several, keyed by flow id.

parallelize_flows.description: Override the suite's own parallel execution setting.

variables.description: Key-value variables attached to the build being run.

web_browser.description: Browser to run a web flow in.

dependencies.description: Chrome extensions to load, overriding the app's defaults for this run.

device.description: Execution target for a mobile run -- model, OS version, physical or virtual.

devices.description: Exactly two device entries, for a flow that spans two devices.

output.description: The started batch, with its batch_id and the runs queued.

get_run_status.title: Get a run batch's status
get_run_status.description: Poll a batch started by run_flows and see each run's state, progress and result. Poll this rather than the per-run endpoint while a batch is still going.

output.description: The runs in the batch with their statuses and ids.

get_run.title: Get a run's results
get_run.description: Read one finished run, with its verdict, the steps the agent took, any issues it flagged and the URLs of its video and other artefacts.

run_id.description: Run UUID, from a run status response.

output.description: The run's result, steps, issues and artefact URLs.

terminate_run.title: Terminate a run
terminate_run.description: Stop a run or flow group that is still going, which is how a stuck or superseded CI run is cut short.

run_id.description: UUID of the run or flow group run to stop.

output.description: Confirmation that the run was terminated.

list_devices.title: List available devices
list_devices.description: List the device models and OS versions that cloud runs can request, each model once with its supported versions. Filter to virtual or physical devices with physical.

physical.description: True for physical devices, false for virtual ones.

output.description: The device models with their supported OS versions.

list_apps.title: List apps
list_apps.description: List the apps and websites registered in the organization, with their platform and active build. Filter by platform to find, say, the Chrome extensions.

output.description: The apps with their ids, platforms and active builds.

list_app_dependencies.title: List an app's default extensions
list_app_dependencies.description: List the Chrome extensions a web app loads by default on every run.

app_id.description: Web app UUID whose dependencies to list.

output.description: The extension apps attached to the web app.

attach_app_dependency.title: Attach an extension to an app
attach_app_dependency.description: Make a Chrome extension load by default on a web app's runs. The primary app must be a web app and the dependency a chrome-extension app.

app_id.description: Web app UUID to attach the extension to.

dependency_app_id.description: UUID of the chrome-extension app to attach.

output.description: The app with the attached extension and its active build.

detach_app_dependency.title: Detach an extension from an app
detach_app_dependency.description: Stop loading a Chrome extension by default. Future runs change; finished runs keep the extension builds they used.

dependency_app_id.description: UUID of the extension app to detach.

output.description: Confirmation that the extension was detached.

list_labels.title: List labels
list_labels.description: List the organization's labels with their colours, the tags that let a run say "everything marked smoke".

output.description: The labels with their ids, names and colours.

get_label.title: Get a label
get_label.description: Read one label by id, with its name and colour.

output.description: The label record.

create_label.title: Create a label
create_label.description: Create a label. Names are unique per organization, case-insensitively, and the colour defaults to one derived from the name.

name.description: Label name, 1 to 255 characters, unique in the organization.

color.description: Hex colour for the label, e.g. "#eb5757".

output.description: The created label, with its id.

update_label.title: Update a label
update_label.description: Rename a label or change its colour. Renaming to a name already in use is refused.

output.description: The updated label.

delete_label.title: Delete a label
delete_label.description: Delete a label. Flows and suites carrying it simply lose the tag.

output.description: Empty on success.

attach_label_to_flow.title: Attach a label to a flow
attach_label_to_flow.description: Tag a flow with a label, so a run targeting that label picks it up.

output.description: Confirmation that the label is attached.

detach_label_from_flow.title: Detach a label from a flow
detach_label_from_flow.description: Remove a label from a flow, leaving both intact.

output.description: Empty on success.

attach_label_to_suite.title: Attach a label to a suite
attach_label_to_suite.description: Tag a suite with a label, so a run targeting that label runs the whole suite.

output.description: Confirmation that the label is attached.

detach_label_from_suite.title: Detach a label from a suite
detach_label_from_suite.description: Remove a label from a suite, leaving both intact.

output.description: Empty on success.

list_hooks.title: List hooks
list_hooks.description: List the scripts that set app state around flows -- curl calls, Python, bash, launch arguments -- optionally narrowed to one flow or suite.

flow_id.description: Restrict to hooks attached to this flow. Not with suite_id.

suite_id.description: Restrict to hooks attached to this suite. Not with flow_id.

output.description: The hooks with their names, types and scripts.

get_hook.title: Get a hook
get_hook.description: Read one hook by id, with its script, type and description.

output.description: The hook record.

create_hook.title: Create a hook
create_hook.description: Add a script that flows can invoke as ${hooks:NAME} -- seeding data with a curl call, resetting an account with Python, or passing launch arguments to the app under test.

name.description: Hook name, 1 to 255 characters; referenced as ${hooks:NAME}.

script.description: The script itself -- a curl command, Python source, and so on.

script_type.description: What kind of script it is.

output.description: The created hook, with its id.

update_hook.title: Update a hook
update_hook.description: Change a hook's script, type or description. Passing an empty string or null to description clears it.

description.description: New description; empty or null clears it.

output.description: The updated hook.

delete_hook.title: Delete a hook
delete_hook.description: Delete a hook. A hook still attached to flows or suites is refused unless force is true, which detaches it from them as it goes.

force.description: True to delete even while the hook is in use.

output.description: Empty on success.

test_hook.title: Test a hook
test_hook.description: Run a hook once against an environment's variables and see what it returned -- the way to check a curl hook before wiring it into a flow. script_override tries a change without saving it.

environment_id.description: Environment whose variables to inject into the run.

script_override.description: Script to run instead of the saved one, without saving it.

output.description: The hook's output, exit status and any error.

list_environments.title: List environments
list_environments.description: List the organization's environments with the variables in each. Secret values come back masked.

output.description: The environments with their variables.

get_env_var.title: Get an environment variable
get_env_var.description: Read one environment variable by id. A secret's value is returned as *** rather than in the clear.

output.description: The variable's key, value or mask, and description.

create_env_var.title: Create an environment variable
create_env_var.description: Add a variable to an environment, referenced from flows and curl hooks as ${env:KEY}. Set is_secret to store it vault-encrypted, after which the value can never be read back.

key.description: Variable name, 1 to 255 characters, used as ${env:KEY}.

value.description: The value; empty strings are rejected.

description.description: Note about what the variable is for.

is_secret.description: True to store the value encrypted and unreadable.

output.description: The created variable, with its id.

update_env_var.title: Update an environment variable
update_env_var.description: Change a variable's key, value, description or secrecy. Renaming the key breaks flows and hooks that still reference the old name, and switching is_secret requires sending the value again.

value.description: New value; omit to keep the current one.

description.description: New description; empty or null clears it.

is_secret.description: Move the variable between plaintext and vault storage.

output.description: The updated variable.

delete_env_var.title: Delete an environment variable
delete_env_var.description: Delete a variable. Flows and hooks that reference it by ${env:KEY} will fail to resolve on their next run.

output.description: Empty on success.
